newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen making further gains.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen making further gains.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks are expected to make further gains on Thursday, but profit-taking could curb upward momentum, brokers said.
"Overall, the index should continue to move up because there is enough buying already waiting to come in," said Sriyan Gurusinghe of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
"But profit-taking, mainly by retailers, will continue because there have been huge gains in recent days," he added.
Colombo stocks have risen by more than 30 percent this year on improved investor sentiment and falling interest rates, brokers said.
